Name: Ancient Crops
Author: TrentXV
Description:
[left][i]﻿Now updated for 1.6 thanks to the hard work of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/0Logophile0?gameId=1303]0Logophile0[/url]﻿![/i]

[b][size=3]Please upload translations separately! This mod is not updated often![/size][/b]

Gunther was impressed by your ability to grow that ancient seed. Maybe you'll have good luck growing these seed packets he found.

You can discover the new items through gameplay or you can check out the guide:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/271]Guide to this mod (Spoilers!)[/url]﻿

[b]Install guide:[/b]
1) Download and install Content Patcher and Spacecore.
2) Download this mod and extract the zip file into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

[b]Updating from before 1.6:[/b]
Items made with the old version of Ancient Crops WILL NOT convert to the new version.
You can use the mod CJB Item Spawner to replace your hard-earned items. The quests will trigger again.
[b]Make sure to delete the old (prior to 1.6) version of Ancient Crops![/b]
